items.text: Green Bay: DNP - LB Zaire Franklin (shin fracture), G Sean Rhyan (ankle, out ~a month), G/T Travis Glover (knee), TE Josh Whyle (concussion); limited - WR Christian Watson (ribs), CB Keisean Nixon (groin), G Aaron Banks, RB Chris Brooks. EDGE Micah Parsons practicing off PUP, targeting Thanksgiving week. Jordan Love starts.

New England: DNP - WR A.J. Brown (ankle/knee), TE Hunter Henry (foot), DT Christian Barmore (illness), RB TreVeyon Henderson; limited - S Kevin Byard, CB Carlton Davis III, OT Morgan Moses, LB Gabe Jacas, OLB Dre'Mont Jones. QB Drake Maye (right shoulder) full. WR Romeo Doubs, G Mike Onwenu on IR.
